paint: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual 3D game material base-color texture sheet. Reference image is color/material guidance only, do NOT draw an aircraft. Create ONE square high resolution flat albedo texture sheet divided into EXACTLY FOUR equal full-width horizontal strips edge-to-edge with NO gutters, NO labels, NO borders. Strip 1 top quarter: dark desaturated forest-green WWII Japanese aircraft painted aluminum. Strip 2 second quarter: warm light gray slightly ivory aircraft painted aluminum. Strip 3 third quarter: black charcoal engine-cowling enamel. Strip 4 bottom quarter: muted golden ochre-yellow recognition paint. Each strip is entirely filled by its respective material, subtle coherent rectangular aircraft panels with very fine seams, tiny sparse rivets, restrained micro scratches and small edge wear, modest paint tonal variations. All strips have uniform diffuse neutral illumination without shadows or lighting gradients, no ambient occlusion, no perspective, no highlights, no emboss, no cast shadows. Seam and rivet thickness must remain delicate. No insignias, no red circles, no wings, no aircraft parts silhouettes, no typography, no logos. Premium realistic clean maintained paint finish, slight service wear rather than derelict, suited to a low-poly aircraft close studio render and top-down game. Materials match the reference green Zero with gray underside black cowling and ochre wing leading strips.
